title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a Gas Transportation Agreement with Distrigas of Massachusetts, LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that thepricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection form public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-04)
